dr_sweep.label: near-goal ON · comp off
dr_sweep.description: near-goal (at-goal) start curriculum ON: 80% of episodes start near the goal at iteration 0, annealed to 0% by iteration 500; payload gravity compensation OFF: plug weight makes the gripper sink under zero action

dr_sweep_noatgoal.label: near-goal OFF · comp off
dr_sweep_noatgoal.description: near-goal start curriculum OFF: every episode starts from the approach pose from iteration 0; payload gravity compensation OFF: plug weight makes the gripper sink under zero action

dr_sweep_comp.label: near-goal ON · comp on
dr_sweep_comp.description: near-goal (at-goal) start curriculum ON: 80% of episodes start near the goal at iteration 0, annealed to 0% by iteration 500; payload gravity compensation ON: controller cancels the grasped plug's weight (no zero-action sag)

dr_sweep_noatgoal_comp.label: near-goal OFF · comp on
dr_sweep_noatgoal_comp.description: near-goal start curriculum OFF: every episode starts from the approach pose from iteration 0; payload gravity compensation ON: controller cancels the grasped plug's weight (no zero-action sag)

dr_sweep_comp_stdfix.label: near-goal ON · comp on · std global
dr_sweep_comp_stdfix.description: Std-instability A/B: dr_sweep_comp variants that blew up, with one learned action std shared across states (agent.policy.state_dependent_std=false)

dr_sweep_osccap.label: near-goal ON · comp off · gain DR capped
